name: mdbook-comments-tests
description: Playwright tests for mdbook-comments with json-server backend

scripts.build: pnpm run build:base && pnpm run build:adapters
scripts.build:adapters: esbuild src/adapters/json-server.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=js/comments-json-server-adapter.js --target=es2020 && esbuild src/adapters/supabase.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=js/comments-supabase-adapter.js --target=es2020 && esbuild src/adapters/googlesheets.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=js/comments-googlesheets-adapter.js --target=es2020 && esbuild src/adapters/custom.ts --bundle --minify --sourcemap --outfile=js/comments-custom-adapter.js --target=es2020
